parameters.name: group_col
parameters.description: the dudetailsummary grouping to rank, region or station (the lowercase aliases of the join subquery)

parameters.name: direction
parameters.description: DESC for the highest net cleared energy, ASC for the lowest

sql_template: SELECT u.{group_col}, round(sum(l.TOTALCLEARED)*5/60,1) AS e FROM dispatchload l JOIN (SELECT DUID, REGIONID AS region, STATIONID AS station FROM dudetailsummary) u USING (DUID) WHERE l.INTERVENTION=0 GROUP BY 1 ORDER BY e {direction}, 1 LIMIT 1

steps.cmd: fill every slot of sql_template from the question's declared parameters and save it as filled.sql
steps.pass: filled.sql contains no remaining {slot} and quotes no value of its own
the JSON prints one row of two columns, the group label and the rounded MWh, and carries no error key
PASS question, PASS sql, PASS values

notes: sum TOTALCLEARED including negative values: a unit charging or consuming has negative output, and clipping it at zero changes both the total and which group is lowest.
always filter INTERVENTION = 0; the intervention rows are a second run of the same interval and double count it.
energy in MWh is MW times 5 divided by 60 because every dispatch interval is five minutes, and the group label comes back with the figure so the answer is the pair, not the number alone.
dudetailsummary has one row per DUID in this data, so the join to dispatchload adds no rows; a join that fans out would inflate every total.
